### Better Than Everest
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/better-than-everest
Passage: Romans 8:28
Points:
- Resting inside the promise of Romans 8:28 provides greater stability than Mount Everest.
- Earthly security measures and diversions are fragile shelters that cannot prevent fear and confusion.
- Believing that God sovereignly directs every joy and trial brings deep freedom and stability.
- Living in the reality of this future grace empowers believers to be fearless and generous.

### God Is for Us
Author: Guy Richard
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-is-for-us
Passage: Romans 8:31
Points:
- Romans 8:31 has served as a foundational source of courage throughout church history.
- Jesus endured divine judgment on the cross so believers would never face God’s condemnation.
- Because the sovereign God is for His people, no circumstance or adversary can ultimately prevail against them.
- Meditating deeply on God’s unfailing favor brings peace during the hardest trials of life.
